question: How is the ritual offering presented to Sadāśiva as the abode of gods and siddhas?
premises: Sadāśiva is addressed as the abode of gods and siddhas.
An offering is declared as given.
The dedication is repeated in ritual form.
inference: The formula presents the given offering to Sadāśiva, the abode of gods and siddhas.
uncertainties: The token sadā0 appears truncated in the source.
plain_english: To the one who is the abode of gods and siddhas, this offering is given, O Sadāśiva; this is for Sadāśiva.
